hints.title: Compare Character Frequencies
hints.text: Both strings have identical length. An anagram requires matching character counts.

hints.title: Count Surplus Characters
hints.text: Count frequencies in s and t. Sum max(0, count_s[c] - count_t[c]) for all letters.

hints.title: Total Minimum Steps
hints.text: Each surplus character in s requires exactly one replacement in t. The total surplus count is the answer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of s and t
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching for character matches individually takes quadratic time O(N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed-size frequency arrays count characters in linear time and constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate counts letter differences and recognizes each substitution fixes one mismatch.
complexity.notes: Alphabet consists only of lowercase English letters.
